article.hook: You hesitate before the spotlight, wondering if you really belong there. Chiron in Leo makes the ache of wanting to be seen without a show impossible to ignore. It’s not about applause - it’s about being visible without a mask.
article.lived: This wound unfolds over years, shaping how we carry pride and vulnerability together. We notice it when someone freezes before speaking up, or when a compliment feels like a trap. The daily push isn’t about dazzling anyone but about standing firm in your own quiet light, even when it trembles.
article.turn: The gift flips when we start trading authenticity for approval. Overperforming becomes a shield against the fear of being overlooked, turning presence into performance. You don’t heal this by rehearsing louder - you heal it by showing up exactly as you are, no curtain call needed.
moves: Say one thing about yourself without adding a justification or excuse.
Wear something this week that feels like it belongs to you alone, no audience required.
In conversation, pause before your usual self-edit and let one imperfect thought out.
